examples.text: Our next warm-up is a tongue twister.
examples.translationZh: 下一个热身内容是绕口令。

examples.text: Tongue twisters always frustrate me because I cannot say them correctly.
examples.translationZh: 绕口令一向让我很头大，因为我总是说错。

examples.text: The problem is when to get the money we need.
examples.translationZh: 问题是什么时候能得到我们所需要的钱。

examples.text: If Peter had applied for the post, he would probably get it now.
examples.translationZh: 要是彼得申请了那职位,他很可能现在就得到了。

examples.text: She soon got the children ready for school.
examples.translationZh: 她很快帮孩子做好上学的准备。

examples.text: It's Friday.
examples.translationZh: 今天星期五。

examples.text: It irks us to wait for people who are late.
examples.translationZh: 等候迟到的人使我们厌烦。

examples.text: "Where's your car?""It's in the garage."
examples.translationZh: “你的汽车在哪儿呢?”“在车库里。”

examples.text: Can you feel the tension in this room?
examples.translationZh: 你能觉察出这房间里的紧张气氛吗？

examples.text: Take a deep breath, and you will feel relaxed.
examples.translationZh: 深深地吸一口气,那样你会觉得轻松的。

examples.text: She felt the child's forehead to see if he was feverish.
examples.translationZh: 她摸孩子的前额去看他是不是发烧了。

examples.text: I've been writing for three hours.
examples.translationZh: 我已经写了三个小时了。

examples.text: Nature inspired him to write such beautiful poems.
examples.translationZh: 自然赋予他灵感,使他写出如此优美的诗句。

examples.text: But there are some parts of the world where even now people cannot write.
examples.translationZh: 但直到现在,世界上有些地方的人们还不会书写。

examples.text: Let me see.
examples.translationZh: 让我想一想。

examples.text: They paid me the princely sum of USD5000.
examples.translationZh: 他们慷慨地给我5000美元。

examples.text: Give it to me.
examples.translationZh: 把它给我！

examples.text: Please sit down.
examples.translationZh: 请坐下。

examples.text: He is walking down the seaside.
examples.translationZh: 他正沿海边走去。

examples.text: I've been feeling down since I lost my job.
examples.translationZh: 自从失去工作後,我的情绪一直处於低潮。

examples.text: The boys were regaling on ice cream cones.
examples.translationZh: 男孩们在美滋滋地大吃冰淇淋。

examples.text: Mother knows how to make ice cream.
examples.translationZh: 母亲会做冰淇淋。

examples.text: The little boy ran off to get his brother.
examples.translationZh: 这个小男孩跑去找他的哥哥。

examples.text: We ran into port for supplies.
examples.translationZh: 我们驶进港口装补给品.

examples.text: I can't make this machine run properly.
examples.translationZh: 我无法使这部机器正常运转。

examples.text: A cat mews.
examples.translationZh: 猫喵喵叫。

examples.text: The cat lapped up the milk.
examples.translationZh: 猫舔食牛奶。

examples.text: The cat is playing with a live mouse.
examples.translationZh: 猫在戏弄那只活老鼠。

examples.text: She hasn't been out riding since the accident.
examples.translationZh: 她自从出了事故以后，一直没有骑马外出过。

examples.text: I can ride a bicycle, and I can drive a car, but I can not ride a horse.
examples.translationZh: 我会骑自行车，而且我会开汽车。但我不会骑马。

examples.text: You'll never learn to ride a bicycle if you don't practise.
examples.translationZh: 如果你不练习,就学不会骑自行车。

examples.text: The aircraft was flying above thick fog.
examples.translationZh: 飞机在浓雾上空飞行。

examples.text: How time flies!
examples.translationZh: 时间过得真快！

examples.text: She will drive to, but fly back from, London.
examples.translationZh: 她将坐汽车去伦敦，坐飞机从伦敦回来。

examples.text: If you pull this lever, the roof will slide back.
examples.translationZh: 拉一下这根杆,顶就往后滑动。

examples.text: The book slid off my knee.
examples.translationZh: 书从我膝上滑落。

examples.text: House values may begin to slide.
examples.translationZh: 房价可能开始逐渐下降了。

examples.text: Pick out some good apples from the box, and throw away the rest.
examples.translationZh: 把好苹果从盒子里捡出来,剩下的扔了。

examples.text: The trees threw long shadows across the lawn.
examples.translationZh: 树在草坪上都投下长长的影子。

examples.text: It's your turn to throw the dice.
examples.translationZh: 轮到你掷骰子了。

examples.text: Every time I see a beautiful scene, I sketch it in my sketch book.
examples.translationZh: 每次我看到美丽的风景，我都会画在我的素描簿中。

examples.text: I apologized to her for stepping on her foot.
examples.translationZh: 我因踩了她一脚向她道歉。

examples.text: I hurt my foot while playing football.
examples.translationZh: 在踢足球时,我的脚受伤了。

examples.text: They sank the post two feet deep in the ground.
examples.translationZh: 他们把这根柱子在地下埋了两英尺深。

examples.text: She married a man who put her on a pedestal.
examples.translationZh: 她嫁给了一个对她十分崇拜的男人。

examples.text: All men are born equal.
examples.translationZh: 人生而平等。

examples.text: He played the man in the time of great trouble.
examples.translationZh: 他在极为困难的时候显示出男子汉的气概。

examples.text: She was singing a lullaby to her child.
examples.translationZh: 她正在给孩子唱摇篮曲。

examples.text: Let's sing a song during the break.
examples.translationZh: 我们趁这空当儿唱支歌。

examples.text: She sang the baby to sleep.
examples.translationZh: 她给孩子唱歌唱到孩子睡着。

examples.text: Well, and who may you be?
examples.translationZh: 那麽，你是谁呢?

examples.text: That might be our taxi.
examples.translationZh: 那辆有可能是我们的计程车。

examples.text: That may be our taxi now!
examples.translationZh: 那辆可能就是我们的计程车了。

examples.text: Good afternoon!
examples.translationZh: 下午好！

examples.text: She could knit up a baby's coatee in an afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 她一个下午就能编结好一件婴孩的紧身短上衣。

examples.text: I met him in a hot and breathless afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 我是在一个又闷又热的下午遇到他的。

examples.text: Their sitting room was enormous.
examples.translationZh: 他们的起居室很大。

examples.text: He is vacuuming a rug in the sitting room.
examples.translationZh: 他在起居室里用吸尘器打扫地毯。

examples.text: Their dining room is very spacious.
examples.translationZh: 他们的餐厅很宽敞。

examples.text: Give the bottle a couple of shakes before pouring the juice.
examples.translationZh: 倒果汁前，先把瓶子摇几下。

examples.text: He shook his head in disapproval.
examples.translationZh: 他摇了摇头表示反对。

examples.text: His voice shook with fear.
examples.translationZh: 他害怕得声音发抖。

examples.text: Ten soldiers were told off to dig ditches.
examples.translationZh: 十名战士被分派去挖沟。

examples.text: He was buried by an avalanche and had to be dug out.
examples.translationZh: 他遇雪崩被埋住了，得把他挖出来。

examples.text: An old Greek statue was dug up here last month.
examples.translationZh: 上个月在这儿挖出了一尊古希腊雕像。

examples.text: He sat at his desk working.
examples.translationZh: 他坐在桌子旁边工作。

examples.text: The students sit in a circle on the floor.
examples.translationZh: 学生们在地板上坐成一圈。

examples.text: There is a sparrow sitting on a branch.
examples.translationZh: 有只麻雀栖在树枝上。

examples.text: Silkworms make cocoons.
examples.translationZh: 蚕做茧。

examples.text: A cocoon is a kind of silk covering made by an insect.
examples.translationZh: 蚕茧是由昆虫制造的一种由丝组成的外包层。

examples.text: The children tore the cocoon open to see if there was a pupa.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们撕开蚕茧看看里面有没有蛹。

examples.text: He robs her of money.
examples.translationZh: 他抢夺她的财产。

examples.text: Time is money.
examples.translationZh: 时间就是金钱。

examples.text: Money doesn't always bring happiness.
examples.translationZh: 金钱并不一定带来快乐。

examples.text: The inscription on the stone had worn away.
examples.translationZh: 刻在石头上的文字已磨损了。

examples.text: Machines soon wear out under rough usage.
examples.translationZh: 机器如果使用不仔细, 很快就会磨损。

examples.text: It was a freak of mine to wear pink pajamas.
examples.translationZh: 穿上粉红色睡衣是我一时的奇想。

examples.text: Money can't buy happiness.
examples.translationZh: 金钱买不来幸福。

examples.text: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.translationZh: 我请他喝酒以酬谢他的帮助。

examples.text: I'd like to buy a strong household bleach.
examples.translationZh: 我想买强力家用漂白剂。

examples.text: He poised the glass on the shelf.
examples.translationZh: 他把玻璃杯稳稳地放在架子上。

examples.text: There were a lot of books on the shelves along the walls.
examples.translationZh: 靠墙的书架上有许多书。

examples.text: Please lift the box down from the shelf for me.
examples.translationZh: 请帮我把这只箱子从搁板上抬下来。

examples.text: Her name will help to sell the film.
examples.translationZh: 有她的名字，这部影片就卖座。

examples.text: The group's record has sold millions.
examples.translationZh: 他们的唱片已经售出了千千万万张了。

examples.text: I'd like to buy your house if you are willing to sell it.
examples.translationZh: 如果你愿意卖的话，我想买你的房子。

examples.text: I couldn't think of the name of that man anyhow.
examples.translationZh: 我怎么也想不出那人的名字来了。

examples.text: He would never think of letting his daughter marry a fellow like you.
examples.translationZh: 他决不会想到让女儿嫁给像你这样的家伙。

examples.text: She thought of several possibilities.
examples.translationZh: 她考虑了几种可能的情况。

examples.text: He is a Dane inasmuch as he was born in Denmark, but he became a British citizen at the age of 30.
examples.translationZh: 他按其出生在丹麦来说是丹麦人，但他在30岁时成了英国公民。

examples.text: She was born in America.
examples.translationZh: 她出生于美国。

examples.text: She was born in 1950.
examples.translationZh: 她生於1950年。

examples.text: He drubbed his opponent in the table tennis match.
examples.translationZh: 他在乒乓球比赛中大胜对手。

examples.text: Yes, table tennis is an Olympic sport.
examples.translationZh: 是的，乒乓球是奥运项目。

examples.text: It's up to you to choose where we should go.
examples.translationZh: 我们要去的地点,由你负责选择。

examples.text: He will choose banking as his career.
examples.translationZh: 他将选择银行业做为职业。

examples.text: He chose not to go home until later.
examples.translationZh: 他决定晚一点才回家。

examples.text: I met Lily on my way to school.
examples.translationZh: 我在去学校的路上遇见了莉莉。
examples.author: Palabra 编辑补充

examples.text: She got on the bus and picked a seat up front.
examples.translationZh: 她上了公车,找了个最前面的座位。

examples.text: He can always get on well with his colleagues.
examples.translationZh: 他总能和同事们和睦相处。

examples.text: Jason saw me and got off the horse immediately.
examples.translationZh: 杰逊看到我，立即从马上下来。

examples.text: A good lawyer might be able to get you off.
examples.translationZh: 请位好律师有可能使你免受追究。

examples.text: We will get off after breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 我们将于早餐后出发。

examples.text: Go straight on until you come to a bus stop.
examples.translationZh: 你一直往前走，直到公共汽车站为止。

examples.text: The bus stop is just across the street.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车站就在街对过。

examples.text: I taught her to ride a bicycle.
examples.translationZh: 我教她骑自行车。

examples.text: His parents employed a tutor to teach him Greek.
examples.translationZh: 他父母雇佣了一位家庭教师来教他希腊语。

examples.text: Parents should teach their children table manners.
examples.translationZh: 双亲应该教导他们的小孩餐桌礼仪。

examples.text: Automobiles must make way for a fire engine.
examples.translationZh: 任何车辆都必须为消防车让路。

examples.text: When the fire engine arrived, the fire was blazing.
examples.translationZh: 消防车到时，火正在炽烈燃烧着。

examples.text: Her maid helped her to dress up for the party.
examples.translationZh: 她的女仆帮助她穿上参加晚会的礼服。

examples.text: They all dressed up to take part in the parade.
examples.translationZh: 他们都穿上盛装去参加游行。

examples.text: She kept her promise to visit her aunt regularly.
examples.translationZh: 她信守诺言，定期去看望姑妈。

examples.text: He picked up his knife and fork.
examples.translationZh: 他捡起了刀叉。

examples.text: He picked up the child and put her on his shoulders.
examples.translationZh: 他抱起孩子让她骑在自己的肩膀上。

examples.text: He picked up news from all sources.
examples.translationZh: 他从各种渠道收集消息。

examples.text: He swore by Jupiter not to tell a lie again.
examples.translationZh: 他对天发誓再也不说谎了。

examples.text: She will tell lies without scruple.
examples.translationZh: 她会肆无忌惮地说谎。

examples.text: We could see lights twinkling in the little town below.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以看见下面的小镇灯光闪耀。

examples.text: He stared up at the stars twinkling in the sky above him.
examples.translationZh: 他抬眼凝视着头顶上方星光闪烁的天空。

examples.text: The dancer's feet twinkled.
examples.translationZh: 舞蹈演员的脚在轻快地移动。

examples.text: She cried with grief when she heard news of her friend's death.
examples.translationZh: 听到朋友死亡的消息，她难过地哭了。

examples.text: She began to cry in the face of failure.
examples.translationZh: 面对失败，她开始哭了起来。

examples.text: He cried that he had found the key.
examples.translationZh: 他大声地叫喊找到了钥匙。

examples.text: Tomorrow we'll go to pick berries.
examples.translationZh: 明天我们去采浆果。

examples.text: The berry is nutritious and has a sweetish taste.
examples.translationZh: 浆果有营养并且有一种带甜味的口味。

reviewScope: 所有记录自动检查；补充及标记项逐项审核，各册抽查；未逐句人工审校全库。
